proposals.evidence: DEDR 844 directly compares Tamil/Malayalam ellām, Kannada ella/ellarum and Kodagu ellā all. The survey simple universal quantifier matches the entry. Human plural ellāru(m) is an attested member of the same quantifier paradigm. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
